text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is staring intently at a magazine...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Golden cream... Is that sea urchin?
It's glistening on the pasta... like jewels...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and this one... warm pancakes with cold ice cream...
So much fresh fruit... How extravagant...
choice_data_list: Did you find a restaurant you're interested in?
Did you find a restaurant you're interested in?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was actually picking somewhere to go on my next day off,
but there are so many restaurants compared to back home... It's taking a while.
choice_data_list: Did you decide on a place?
Did you decide on a place?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A place famous for its pasta and pancakes.
Apparently, it's what they call a "hidden gem."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However... the other day, I saw an ad for a ramen shop just like this
and went looking for it, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even though I checked the map and rode the right train,
I couldn't find it anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a "hidden" shop.
...It won't give up its secrets easily.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wait...
Could it be operating in disguise, blending into the mortal realm...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... If not, then why couldn't I find it?
It's truly a mystery.

Looking at the magazine's map, it's very basic
and confusing. It might be tough for Oguri Cap to go alone...
choice_data_list: Want me to go with you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! Really, would you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If you're with me, Trainer, I'll feel much safer.
I'll gladly take you up on that. Thank you.

On our next day off, after a short train ride,
we arrived at the cafe Oguri Cap wanted to visit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So this is the place... We didn't get lost at all.
Impressive, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just... I didn't expect it to look so chic...
I feel a little out of place.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are my clothes okay for this place? I heard some city restaurants
turn you away if you don't follow their dress code.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's a relief.
Still... I can't quite relax.

text_block_list.name: Staff Member A
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your order?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, what was it again...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes. But the names are so difficult...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They sounded French... full of foreign words...
One of them was the sea urchin pasta, but what was it called...
choice_data_list: Two of the sea urchin pastas, please.

text_block_list.name: Staff Member A
text_block_list.text: Ah, that would be our Lumière Dorée Sea Urchin Cream Pasta.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So you don't have to use the exact formal name.
...All right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could we also get two of the pancakes
piled high with fruit, please?

text_block_list.name: Staff Member A
text_block_list.text: Certainly, two Fruits Crêpes coming right up~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Did you see that, Trainer?
Even I managed to order properly.

Oguri Cap had seemed nervous in the unfamiliar environment,
but after eating, her tension melted away completely—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That was delicious... A flavor I've never experienced before.
It melted in my mouth and vanished in an instant...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I have a proposal. Shall we order seconds?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It disappeared so quickly that I didn't get to savor it enough.
Since we came all the way out here—
choice_data_list: Seconds are great, but why not try something else?
Seconds sound good, but want to try something else?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Something else... Now that you mention it, that's a good idea too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Both the pasta and pancakes were wonderfully seasoned,
so the rest of the menu is bound to be just as delicious.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In that case, what would be the best choice...?
Mmm, this is a difficult decision.
Oguri Cap stared down the menu for several minutes—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's no use, I can't decide!
Everything looks so good, I want to order all of it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Wait, wouldn't that solve the problem?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you say we order
every single item listed on the menu?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...No good? Then could you choose for us?
Which dish catches your eye?
choice_data_list: The Hamburger Steak Baked in Puff Pastry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I've never heard of that dish before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since we're here, let's try it.
Allow me to place the order.

Oguri Cap raised her hand happily like a child calling a teacher,
and ordered "that hamburger pastry thing."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Crispy puff pastry with a perfectly sweet and tart berry sauce,
wrapping around a succulent, juicy hamburger steak—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It was a blissful moment, like living in a dream.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. I couldn't quite picture fruit sauce on a hamburger steak,
but it really works.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
Thanks to you, my culinary horizons have expanded.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trying foods recommended by the person you're eating with,
rather than sticking only to your own favorites, is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for today.
The food was delicious, and I had a great time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that.
Today has been a truly great day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's head to the next shop.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I usually only visit places near the academy,
but since you offered to be my guide today...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I picked out several other places to check out.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We might miss lunchtime at some,
but going by my appetite, I could easily visit ten more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'll be spending the whole day cafe hopping.
I'm looking forward to it, Trainer.

Matching steps with an unusually brisk Oguri Cap,
we continued our cafe tour right up until curfew...
